title: Nazar
name: Nazar · Spot the hazard early
practise: Seeing a hazard while it develops: autos cutting in, a child behind a bus, a door opening.
scored: Earlier tap = more points (5 to 1). Tapping all the time scores 0 for that clip, and taps away from hazards count against you. No timer: it's about noticing, not speed.
controls: Tap anywhere on the clip, or press Space or any key. Works with one thumb. No sound needed.
format: Kerala's announced format, as reported: {clips} clips, {marks} marks each, pass {pass} of {total}.
formatOnHold: Kerala's hazard test status changed to {status} (checked {date}). The practice is still useful anywhere.
notTest: Practice on our own AI-generated scenes, not Kerala's test and not a licence test.
photo: Clips are checked for flashing before they're published (no more than 3 flashes a second). Turn on Reduce motion for calmer feedback.
srLinkLine: Using a screen reader? The screen-reader version uses still frames with descriptions. It's a different exercise from the timed clips.
offline: You're offline. Practice works on clips saved on this phone; scores are checked when you're back online.
